description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HealthController that provides a health check endpoint (/healthz). The endpoint returns a JSON response indicating the application's health status. The class is annotated with Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for documentation and is designed to be publicly accessible without authentication.

classes.name: HealthController
classes.description: A REST controller that exposes a health check endpoint (/healthz) for application monitoring and load balancer health checks.

methods.name: getHealth
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /healthz, returning a JSON object with a 'status' key set to 'ok' indicating the application's health.
